person.description: A human being detected in the scene.

bicycle.description: A two-wheeled vehicle powered by pedaling, used for transport and exercise.

car.description: A four-wheeled motor vehicle used to carry a small number of people on roads.

motorcycle.description: A two-wheeled motor vehicle powered by an engine.

airplane.description: A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings, used to carry people and cargo through the air.

bus.description: A large road vehicle that carries many passengers along a fixed route.

train.description: A series of connected carriages that run on rails to carry people or goods.

truck.description: A large motor vehicle designed to carry heavy goods.

boat.description: A small vessel that travels on water.

traffic light.description: A signal with red, yellow and green lights that controls traffic at roads and crossings.

fire hydrant.description: A street connection to the water supply that firefighters use to get water.

stop sign.description: A red octagonal road sign that tells drivers to stop completely.

parking meter.description: A device at the roadside where drivers pay for parking time.

bench.description: A long seat for several people, found in parks and public places.

bird.description: A feathered animal with wings and a beak, and most species can fly.

cat.description: A small domestic mammal kept as a pet, known for being agile and independent.

dog.description: A domestic mammal kept as a pet or working animal, known for loyalty.

horse.description: A large strong animal used for riding, racing and carrying loads.

sheep.description: A farm animal kept for its wool, meat and milk.

cow.description: A large farm animal kept mainly for milk and meat.

elephant.description: The largest land animal, with a long trunk and large ears.

bear.description: A large, heavy mammal with thick fur, found in forests and cold regions.

zebra.description: A wild horse-like animal with black and white stripes.

giraffe.description: The tallest land animal, with a very long neck and legs.

backpack.description: A bag carried on the back, used for books, laptops and daily items.

umbrella.description: A folding canopy on a handle that protects from rain or sun.

handbag.description: A small bag used to carry personal items such as a wallet and phone.

tie.description: A long strip of cloth worn around the neck with a formal shirt.

suitcase.description: A large case with a handle used to carry clothes and belongings when travelling.

frisbee.description: A flat plastic disc thrown between players for fun or sport.

skis.description: Long narrow boards attached to boots for gliding over snow.

snowboard.description: A single wide board ridden down snowy slopes.

sports ball.description: A ball used in sports such as football, cricket, basketball or tennis.

kite.description: A light frame covered with cloth or paper, flown in the wind on a string.

baseball bat.description: A smooth wooden or metal club used to hit the ball in baseball.

baseball glove.description: A padded leather glove worn to catch the ball in baseball.

skateboard.description: A short board on four wheels that a person rides standing up.

surfboard.description: A long board used for riding waves in the sea.

tennis racket.description: A strung frame with a handle used to hit the ball in tennis.

bottle.description: A container for holding liquids such as water or juice.

wine glass.description: A glass with a stem and bowl, used for drinking wine.

cup.description: A small open container used for drinking hot or cold beverages.

fork.description: An eating tool with prongs used to pick up food.

knife.description: A tool with a sharp blade used for cutting food or other materials.

spoon.description: An eating tool with a small shallow bowl used for liquids and soft food.

bowl.description: A deep round dish used for serving or eating food such as soup and cereal.

banana.description: A long curved fruit with a yellow peel and soft sweet flesh.

apple.description: A round fruit with red, green or yellow skin and crisp flesh.

sandwich.description: Two slices of bread with a filling such as meat, cheese or vegetables.

orange.description: A round citrus fruit with a thick orange peel and juicy segments.

broccoli.description: A green vegetable with a thick stalk and small tree-like flower heads.

carrot.description: An orange root vegetable that is crunchy and sweet.

hot dog.description: A cooked sausage served in a soft long bun.

pizza.description: A flat baked bread base topped with cheese, sauce and other toppings.

donut.description: A sweet ring-shaped fried pastry, often glazed or iced.

cake.description: A sweet baked dessert, often made for birthdays and celebrations.

chair.description: A seat for one person, usually with a back and four legs.

couch.description: A long, soft seat for several people, also called a sofa.

potted plant.description: A plant grown in a pot, kept indoors or outdoors for decoration.

bed.description: A piece of furniture with a mattress used for sleeping.

dining table.description: A table where people sit to eat meals.

toilet.description: A bathroom fixture used for sanitation.

tv.description: A screen used to watch videos, shows and other content.

laptop.description: A portable computer used for work, study and entertainment.

mouse.description: A pointing device used to move the cursor on a computer screen.

remote.description: A handheld device used to control a TV or other device from a distance.

keyboard.description: An input device with keys used to type text into a computer.

cell phone.description: A handheld device for calls, messaging, internet and apps.

microwave.description: A kitchen appliance that heats food quickly using microwave radiation.

oven.description: A kitchen appliance with an enclosed space for baking and roasting food.

toaster.description: A small appliance that browns slices of bread using heat.

sink.description: A basin with a tap used for washing hands, dishes and food.

refrigerator.description: An appliance that keeps food and drinks cold so they stay fresh.

book.description: A set of written or printed pages bound together for reading and learning.

clock.description: A device that shows the time.

vase.description: A decorative container, usually used to hold flowers.

scissors.description: A cutting tool with two blades, used for paper, cloth and more.

teddy bear.description: A soft stuffed toy in the shape of a bear.

hair drier.description: A handheld device that blows warm air to dry hair.

toothbrush.description: A small brush with a handle used to clean teeth.
